artworks.title: Messieurs les juré ... l'accusé a tué Jean Maclou ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a group of men standing together. They appear to be engaged in conversation or argument. The figures have exaggerated facial expressions and gestures, common in caricature style. The men are dressed in 19th-century clothing. The background is simple, emphasizing the crowded figures. The drawing is in the style of Honoré Daumier, known for his satirical illustrations of French social and political scenes. The shading and line work contribute to the depth and drama of the image, highlighting the tension among the characters.

artworks.title: Tire ferme, Gaspard ... y va s'neyer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a boat on a river. One man is standing and holding a long pole, the other is seated and leaning towards a person swimming beside the boat. The swimmer is in the foreground with their upper body above the water. In the background, there are buildings and silhouettes of people walking along the riverbank. The illustration is accompanied by a French text titled "Les Philantropes du Jour" (The Philanthropists of the Day) and a satirical dialogue capturing comedic and critical elements common in 19th-century caricatures.

artworks.title: Approchez M. Gérenflot ... venez recevoir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a formal setting. One man is standing on a step, extending a small crown towards the other man who is bowing. The man standing has short dark hair, wears spectacles, a white shirt, and a black jacket. The other man is mostly bald with some hair on the sides and back, dressed in a long dark coat and trousers. Both men are on a platform. In the background, several other men in formal attire are seated, watching. The image is depicted in black and white with shading for depth.

artworks.title: N'ayez pas d'inquiètoude ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men standing on a riverbank. The men are well-dressed wearing top hats and formal coats. One man is gesturing while the other is listening attentively with a cane in hand. The setting suggests a leisurely stroll by the water, with distant figures visible near the shoreline. The style of the drawing is characteristic of satirical or caricature art.

artworks.title: Apportez, messieurs, apportez ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing in front of a large poster or board. The man on the left is in profile, facing right, and appears to have receding hair and a clean-shaven face. He wears a long, light-colored coat with dark pants and shoes. The man in the middle is bent over a table, focusing intently on writing in a notepad or ledger. He has curly, dark hair and wears a dark suit. The third man stands to the right, in profile facing left, with neatly combed back hair. He is dressed in a dark suit. The table in front of them has several bags or pouches placed on it. The background consists of a large sign that reads "CHEMIN DE FER DE PONTOISE À VAUGIRARD 200 MILLIONS CAPITAL SOCIAL." The scene is set in a monochrome style typical of an illustrated print, with text written above and below the image.

artworks.title: Monsieur par suite de la fusion
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men in a room engaged in conversation. The scene depicts an interaction taking place in what appears to be a formal setting. One man is sitting at a desk with a set of drawers, and the other stands beside him, gesturing with his hand. The drawing style is detailed and expressive, capturing the facial expressions and postures of the individuals. The title at the top is "Les Philanthropes du Jour." The background shows wallpaper with a decorative pattern. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Mon cher ami, nous avons appris ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three men are depicted in the image. Two are standing beside the bed of the third man, who appears surprised. The man in the bed is sitting up, with a wide-open mouth and raised eyebrows, wearing a nightcap and a long nightshirt. He has short, wavy hair and a youthful face. The man in the center, leaning towards the person in bed, has facial hair, wearing a long coat and a tall black hat, holding a cane. The man standing behind him also has facial hair and is holding his hat with a stoic expression. Both standing men are dressed in fitted pants and shoes. The setting includes a bedside table with a candlestick holding an extinguished candle, drawn curtains on either side of the bed, and a dimly lit background, creating a sense of intimacy in a private space.

artworks.title: Le mari veut qu'on regarde sa couche ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing side by side, with their full bodies clearly depicted. The man on the left is standing upright with his head turned to the side. He has short, dark hair and is clean-shaven. He is dressed in a knee-length overcoat, pants, and striped socks, with dress shoes on his feet. His hands are clasped behind his back. The man on the right is hunched slightly forward, with his head down, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat that obscures his facial features. He is dressed in a long coat, pants, and holds his hands in front of him, with one hand gesturing outward. Around the two men are foliage and some large vegetables laid out in the foreground. In the background, there is a wall with two open windows. A woman is visible in the upper window, leaning on the windowsill with her chin resting on her hand, looking out. Above the illustration, the title "LES AMIS" is printed.

artworks.title: Un léger coup de vent
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person clinging to a tree. The person is positioned sideways, with both arms wrapped around the tree trunk, and their legs slightly raised. The individual's face is turned towards the viewer, with unkempt hair. The clothing consists of a long coat and trousers, which appear to be fluttering with the movement. The person wears a shoe on one foot, visible as the other foot is tucked under them. A top hat is depicted airborne to the right of the person's head. The background features swirling lines that represent a forceful wind, bending the nearby trees.

artworks.title: Premier grand prix de mathématiques,  M. Cabuchet
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing on a stage facing a man. The boy holds laurel wreaths in each hand. The man has glasses and a round face with short, parted hair. There is an audience of children and adults, a man dabbing his eyes with a cloth, and books on the stage.

artworks.title: Eléves de sixième voulant jouer aux rhétoriciens
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of three individuals portrayed from the waist up. The person on the left is standing slightly turned to his side with his eyes squinted, appearing to make a gesture with his left hand while holding a narrow object to his lips. The middle person is leaning slightly forward, focusing on an open book or document in his hands. The third person to the right is standing with his chest out, eyes nearly closed, and lips pursed around a thin pipe. All three are dressed in formal attire with jackets. The background is minimal, with a plain, shaded backdrop.

artworks.title: Un jour déclipse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals standing closely together, facing the left side of the image. They are dressed in formal wear with top hats, and some have varied hairstyles. One person appears to be holding a large circular object. The background features dense lines and textures. The overall scene has a vintage illustration style in black and white.

artworks.title: Dis donc, ravignard, si nos femmes nous voyaient! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted from the knees up. The man on the left stands with his right hand holding a stick, facing another man on his right. He has short, neatly combed hair and a slightly rounded face, wearing a collared shirt with a checkered pattern vest. The man on the right is leaning towards the first man, holding a glass in each hand, one close to the first man's face. He has a balding head with combed-back hair and a slightly elongated face, dressed in a dark, fitted coat with visible buttons. A wooden table with a jug and a bottle is in the background, along with a plain, partitioned wall with a round object, perhaps a small hat, hanging on it. Text is visible at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Position réputée la plus commode pour un portrait au daguerréotype
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals engaged in a photography session. One person is seated in a suit on a chair next to a small potted plant. The other person is bending forward, looking through the viewfinder of a camera on a tripod, covered with a dark cloth.

artworks.title: Ces artistes sont presque tous fous . . . Ma parole d'honneur!  . . . En voilà un qui a l'idée de faire le portrait d'un vieil arbre!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in the foreground with a puzzled expression on his face. He is standing upright, slightly leaning back, with his hands gesturing outwards. The man has a wrinkled face and a bemused expression, sporting a top hat and a long black coat with a light-colored shirt underneath and trousers. In the background, a figure is seated at an easel beside a rocky and slightly elevated terrain. A small tree or bush is visible near the painter, with additional rocks and vegetation around the area. The setting appears to be outdoor with sparse detailing.

artworks.title: Un amateur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing titled "Les Bons Bourgeois". It depicts a stout man in formal attire, wearing a top hat and holding a magnifying glass. He stands on a cobblestone pavement with a cityscape background. Two elegantly dressed figures are walking away in the background. The artwork is rendered in shades of gray with crosshatching and line work, similar to lithographic prints. Its style and satirical theme are reminiscent of works by Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Inconvénient d'épouser une femme qui possède un talent d'agrément
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaged in reading or singing from a large book in a domestic setting. The drawing depicts a man and a woman standing together, with the woman holding a large open book. The woman appears to be singing or speaking passionately, her mouth open wide, while the man leans toward her, seemingly reacting to what she is doing. The setting includes a curtain in the background and a small table or pedestal to the right holding an object under a dome. The expressions and postures of the characters suggest a humorous or light-hearted narrative. The artwork is presented in a monochrome tone, emphasizing the details of the characters' expressions and the texture of their clothing and surroundings. The drawing likely serves as an illustration within a series, as indicated by the text elements at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Allons bon ... v'la p'tit qui dit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man holding a child in a dynamic stance. The man wears a top hat, coat, and pants. He has a defined facial structure with a mustache. The child wears striped clothing and a bonnet, looking content. A woman in a cloak-like garment stands next to the man. Two other figures are also visible in the background. The setting is an urban street with tall buildings under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Locataires noctambules
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of people moving furniture through a window. The drawing depicts an exterior urban scene at night, with a man leaning out of an upper window, lowering or lifting a piece of furniture with the assistance of someone below. A woman and another person stand nearby watching the process. The buildings are drawn with simple lines and cross-hatching techniques. The text in French suggests the theme of tenants and landlords. Details are outlined in a caricature or satirical style, emphasizing the chaotic nature of moving.

artworks.title: En famille
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features three individuals: an older woman on the left, a child in the middle, and a woman leaning on a railing on the right. In the background, there is water, potentially indicative of a pool or bathing area, with a fourth individual partially visible in the water. The setting seems to be indoors, with tiled walls and a mural-like design in the background.

artworks.title: Parisiens qui ne seront jamais ... sous la surveillance ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three men are seated around a table. They are all visible from the waist up. The man on the left reaches towards the center of the table. The man in the middle leans forward, resting his head on his left hand. The man on the right also leans towards the table. They each have distinct facial features. The man on the left has short hair, the middle man has fuller hair with a receding hairline, and the man on the right has thinning hair and appears older. They are dressed formally with dark jackets and white shirts. The table has a patterned surface. There is a framed picture hanging on the wall.

artworks.title: Faut-y qu'il en ait fume des pipes celui-la
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted in a drawing. One person is shown standing with hands in their pockets. They have a short hairstyle and wear a cap, a loose-fitting shirt, trousers, and boots. Beside them, another person is seated on a ledge with arms crossed. They have short hair and wear a loose shirt, striped pants, and sandals. The background features a sketchy cityscape of buildings. The illustration is on a textured backdrop resembling a printed page with faint text visible.

artworks.title: Nous avons donc volé le ballon de Mr. Green?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing facing each other, engaged in conversation. Both men have distinct expressions and wear similar clothing. The man on the left gestures towards the other man's torso, while the man on the right has his hands behind his back. In the background, there is a rough outdoor scene with a building and foliage. Text above and below the image provides a title and caption.

artworks.title: Moyen d'aller chercher les barbillons dans leur propre domicile
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a person in mid-action trying to catch something from a boat. The figure is dressed in a tailcoat and trousers with a top hat, leaning forward energetically off the edge of a small boat. One arm is extended with a long pole, while the other hand clasps a woven basket. The expression on the figure's face suggests determination, evoking movement and perhaps urgency. In the background, there are buildings that recede into the distance. The illustration's style features fluid, confident lines and light shading typical of satirical or illustrative artwork from the 19th century.
